translationRepairs: In Kangxi 14 Burne's brothers rebelled, were suppressed and executed, and the people were relocated to graze beyond the Xuanhua–Datong border.
In Kangxi 14 his son Burne and his brothers rebelled, were suppressed and executed, and the people were relocated to graze beyond the Xuanhua–Datong border.

s0010 reads 其子布爾呢兄弟叛: 布爾呢兄弟 is Burne together with his brothers as the rebel subject, and 其子 marks Burne as the prior figure's son. The idiomatic "Burne's brothers" wrongly excludes Burne and drops 其子; the proposed wording restores both.
In the fourteenth year of Kangxi, his son Burne's brothers rebelled; they were suppressed and put to death, and the tribespeople were moved to pasture beyond the Xuanhua and Datong frontier.
In the fourteenth year of Kangxi, his son Burne and his brothers rebelled; they were suppressed and put to death, and the tribespeople were moved to pasture beyond the Xuanhua and Datong frontier.

s0010's 布爾呢兄弟 is the classical "X and his brothers" construction, not "the brothers of Burne." The possessive "Burne's brothers" excludes Burne from the rebellion; "his son Burne and his brothers" matches 其子布爾呢兄弟.

units.zh: 志五十六
units.en: Treatise 56
units.literal: Treatise 56.

units.zh: 地理二十八
units.en: Geography 28
units.literal: Geography 28.

units.zh: 察哈爾
units.en: Chahar
units.literal: Chahar.

units.zh: 察哈爾八旗：東南距京師四百三十里。
units.en: The Chahar Eight Banners lie four hundred thirty li southeast of the capital.
units.literal: Chahar Eight Banners: four hundred thirty li southeast of the capital.

units.zh: 當直隸宣化、山西大同邊外。
units.en: Their territory stands beyond the frontier of Xuanhua in Zhili and Datong in Shanxi.
units.literal: They lie beyond the border outside Zhili's Xuanhua and Shanxi's Datong.

units.zh: 明插漢，本元裔小王子後。
units.en: In Ming times this was Cha Han, a people descended from the Yuan collateral line of the Little Prince.
units.literal: In the Ming it was Cha Han, originally descended from the Yuan collateral royal house of the Little Prince.

units.zh: 嘉靖間，布希駐牧察哈爾之地，因以名部。
units.en: During Jiajing, Buxi grazed his people on Chahar lands, and the tribe took its name from that place.
units.literal: During the Jiajing reign, Buxi pastured his herds in Chahar territory, whence the tribe took its name.

units.zh: 天聰六年，征林丹汗，走死。
units.en: In Tiancong 6 the court campaigned against Ligdan Khan, who fled and died.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Tiancong, Ligdan Khan was attacked and fled to his death.

units.zh: 其子孔果爾額哲來降，即其部編旗，駐義州。
units.en: Ligdan's son Kökege Erjen submitted; his people were enrolled in banners and settled at Yizhou.
units.literal: His son Kökege Erjen came to submit; his people were organized into banners and stationed at Yizhou.

units.zh: 康熙十四年，其子布爾呢兄弟叛，討誅之，遷部眾駐牧宣化、大同邊外。
units.en: In Kangxi 14 his son Burne and his brothers rebelled, were suppressed and executed, and the people were relocated to graze beyond the Xuanhua–Datong border.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi, his son Burne and his brothers rebelled; they were suppressed and put to death, and the tribespeople were moved to pasture beyond the Xuanhua and Datong frontier.

units.zh: 又以來降之喀爾喀、厄魯特編為佐領隸焉。
units.en: Submitted Khalkha and Oirat were also enrolled as assistant commandants under its jurisdiction.
units.literal: Khalkha and Oirat who had submitted were also organized as assistant commandants subordinate to it.

units.zh: 乾隆二十六年，設都統，駐張家口。
units.en: In Qianlong 26 a superintendent was appointed, with his seat at Zhangjiakou.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Qianlong a superintendent was established, stationed at Zhangjiakou.

units.zh: 其地東界克什克騰，西界歸化城土默特，南界直隸獨石、張家二口及山西大同、朔平，北界蘇尼特及四子部落。
units.en: On the east it borders Keshiketeng; on the west the Tumet of Guihua; on the south Dushi and Zhangjia passes in Zhili and Datong and Shuoping in Shanxi; on the north Sunite and the Four Sons tribes.
units.literal: Its territory borders on the east Keshiketeng, on the west the Tumet of Guihua City, on the south Zhili's Dushi and Zhangjia passes and Shanxi's Datong and Shuoping, and on the north Sunite and the Four Sons tribes.

units.zh: 袤延千里。
units.en: The region stretches a thousand li end to end.
units.literal: It extends a thousand li in length.

units.zh: 北極高四十二度二十分。
units.en: Its latitude is 42°20′ N.
units.literal: North latitude forty-two degrees twenty minutes.

units.zh: 京師偏西十分。
units.en: It lies ten minutes of longitude west of the capital.
units.literal: Ten minutes west of the capital's meridian.

units.zh: 鑲黃旗察哈爾駐蘇明峰，在張家口北三百四十里。
units.en: Bordered Yellow Banner Chahar is stationed at Suming Peak, three hundred forty li north of Zhangjiakou.
units.literal: Bordered Yellow Banner Chahar is stationed at Suming Peak, three hundred forty li north of Zhangjiakou.

units.zh: 東南距京師七百五十里。
units.en: It lies seven hundred fifty li southeast of the capital.
units.literal: Seven hundred fifty li southeast of the capital.

units.zh: 明，萬全右衛邊外。
units.en: In Ming times it lay beyond the Wanquan Right Guard frontier.
units.literal: Under the Ming, beyond the border of Wanquan Right Guard.

units.zh: 漢，上谷郡。
units.en: In Han times it was Shanggu Commandery.
units.literal: Under the Han, Shanggu Commandery.

units.zh: 牧地當張家口之北。
units.en: Its grazing lands lie north of Zhangjiakou.
units.literal: Its pasture lies north of Zhangjiakou.

units.zh: 東界正白旗察哈爾，西界正黃旗察哈爾，南界鑲黃旗牧廠，北界蘇尼特右翼，廣一百六十里，袤一百九十里。
units.en: It borders Plain White Banner Chahar on the east and Plain Yellow Banner Chahar on the west; on the south the Bordered Yellow Banner pasture office and on the north Sunite Right Wing. It measures one hundred sixty li across and one hundred ninety li in length.
units.literal: On the east it borders Plain White Banner Chahar, on the west Plain Yellow Banner Chahar, on the south the Bordered Yellow Banner pasture office, on the north Sunite Right Wing; one hundred sixty li wide and one hundred ninety li long.

units.zh: 其山：東曰漠爾圖山。
units.en: Its mountains: to the east, Mo'ertu Mountain.
units.literal: Its mountains: on the east, Mo'ertu Mountain.

units.zh: 南，哈石郎山。
units.en: To the south, Hashilang Mountain.
units.literal: To the south, Hashilang Mountain.

units.zh: 北，青羊山蒙名博羅虎插、紅羊山蒙名烏蘭虎插。
units.en: To the north are Qingyang Mountain (Mongol Bolohucha) and Hongyang Mountain (Mongol Ulanhucha).
units.literal: To the north, Qingyang Mountain, Mongol name Bolohucha, and Hongyang Mountain, Mongol name Ulanhucha.

units.zh: 東南，阿哈魯虎山、駱駝山。
units.en: To the southeast, Ahaluhu Mountain and Camel Mountain.
units.literal: To the southeast, Ahaluhu Mountain and Luotuo Mountain.

units.zh: 西南，額類山。
units.en: To the southwest, Elei Mountain.
units.literal: To the southwest, Elei Mountain.

units.zh: 東北，白鹿山蒙名布虎圖。
units.en: To the northeast, White Deer Mountain (Mongol Buhutu).
units.literal: To the northeast, Bailu Mountain, Mongol name Buhutu.

units.zh: 西北，衣爾哈圖山。
units.en: To the northwest, Yi'erhatu Mountain.
units.literal: To the northwest, Yi'erhatu Mountain.

units.zh: 東南：大紅泉蒙名伊克烏蘭。
units.en: To the southeast: Great Red Spring (Mongol Ike Ulan).
units.literal: To the southeast: Great Red Spring, Mongol name Ike Ulan.

units.zh: 西南：滾布拉克泉。
units.en: To the southwest: Gunbulake Spring.
units.literal: To the southwest: Gunbulake Spring.

units.zh: 北：小紅泉。
units.en: To the north: Little Red Spring.
units.literal: To the north: Little Red Spring.

units.zh: 正黃旗察哈爾駐木孫忒克山，在張家口西北三百二十里。
units.en: Plain Yellow Banner Chahar is stationed at Musunteke Mountain, three hundred twenty li northwest of Zhangjiakou.
units.literal: Plain Yellow Banner Chahar is stationed at Musunteke Mountain, three hundred twenty li northwest of Zhangjiakou.

units.zh: 東南距京師七百六十里。
units.en: It lies seven hundred sixty li southeast of the capital.
units.literal: Seven hundred sixty li southeast of the capital.

units.zh: 漢，且如縣地。
units.en: In Han times it was the territory of Qieru County.
units.literal: Under the Han, the territory of Qieru County.

units.zh: 牧地當張家口廳之西北，喀喇烏納根山南。
units.en: Its grazing lands lie northwest of Zhangjiakou Subprefecture, south of Kalauangen Mountain.
units.literal: Its pasture lies northwest of Zhangjiakou Subprefecture, south of Kalauangen Mountain.

units.zh: 東界鑲黃旗察哈爾，西界正紅旗察哈爾，南界陸軍部右翼牧廠，北界四子部落。
units.en: It borders Bordered Yellow Banner Chahar on the east and Plain Red Banner Chahar on the west; on the south the Army Ministry Right Wing pasture office and on the north the Four Sons tribes.
units.literal: On the east it borders Bordered Yellow Banner Chahar, on the west Plain Red Banner Chahar, on the south the Army Ministry's Right Wing pasture office, on the north the Four Sons tribes.

units.zh: 廣一百一十里，袤二百八十里。
units.en: It measures one hundred ten li across and two hundred eighty li in length.
units.literal: One hundred ten li wide and two hundred eighty li long.

units.zh: 其山：東曰額爾吉納克山。
units.en: Its mountains: to the east, Erjinake Mountain.
units.literal: Its mountains: on the east, Erjinake Mountain.

units.zh: 南，烏爾虎拖羅海山。
units.en: To the south, Wu'erhutuoluohai Mountain.
units.literal: To the south, Wu'erhutuoluohai Mountain.

units.zh: 北，大鮮卑山蒙名伊克阿勒特、興安山。
units.en: To the north are Great Xianbei Mountain (Mongol Ike Alet) and Xing'an Mountain.
units.literal: To the north, Great Xianbei Mountain, Mongol name Ike Alet, and Xing'an Mountain.

units.zh: 西南，插漢和邵山。
units.en: To the southwest, Chahanheshao Mountain.
units.literal: To the southwest, Chahanheshao Mountain.

units.zh: 東北，榆樹山蒙名烏里雅蘇台。
units.en: To the northeast, Elm Mountain (Mongol Uriyasutai).
units.literal: To the northeast, Yushu Mountain, Mongol name Uriyasutai.

units.zh: 西：七金河，蒙名賀爾博金，源出賀爾博金山，南流入希爾池。
units.en: To the west: Qijin River (Mongol He'erbojin), which rises on He'erbojin Mountain and flows south into Xier Pool.
units.literal: To the west: Qijin River, Mongol name He'erbojin, rising from He'erbojin Mountain and flowing south into Xier Pool.

units.zh: 東南：兆哈河，源出平地，南流，會烏爾古河。
units.en: To the southeast: Zhaoha River rises on level ground, flows south, and joins the Wu'ergu River.
units.literal: To the southeast: Zhaoha River, rising from level ground, flowing south to join the Wu'ergu River.

units.zh: 又南，蒙古幾河自西來注之。
units.en: Farther south the Mengguji River enters from the west and joins it.
units.literal: Farther south, the Mengguji River enters from the west and joins it.

units.zh: 又南，蘇爾扎河自東北來注之。
units.en: Farther south the Su'erzha River enters from the northeast and joins it.
units.literal: Farther south, the Su'erzha River enters from the northeast and joins it.

units.zh: 又南流，從大同天鎮入邊，逕柴溝堡，西北入懷安，為東洋河。
units.en: Continuing south, it enters the frontier at Tianzhen in Datong, passes Chaigou Fort, turns northwest into Huai'an, and becomes the Dongyang River.
units.literal: It flows on south, enters the border from Datong's Tianzhen, passes through Chaigou Fort, enters Huai'an from the northwest, and becomes the Dongyang River.

units.zh: 蒙古幾河源出平地，東流會兆哈河，南入邊城，弩里河南流從之。
units.en: The Mengguji rises on level ground, flows east to meet the Zhaoha, then turns south into the border; the Nuli River flows south alongside it.
units.literal: The Mengguji River rises from level ground, flows east to join the Zhaoha River, enters the border southward, and the Nuli River flows south along with it.

units.zh: 鑲紅旗察哈爾駐布林泉，在張家口西北四百二十里。
units.en: Bordered Red Banner Chahar is stationed at Bulin Spring, four hundred twenty li northwest of Zhangjiakou.
units.literal: Bordered Red Banner Chahar is stationed at Bulin Spring, four hundred twenty li northwest of Zhangjiakou.

units.zh: 東南距京師八百三十里。
units.en: It lies eight hundred thirty li southeast of the capital.
units.literal: Eight hundred thirty li southeast of the capital.

units.zh: 漢，雁門郡北境。
units.en: In Han times it was the northern border of Yanmen Commandery.
units.literal: Under the Han, the northern border of Yanmen Commandery.

units.zh: 牧地當山西陶林廳之東北代哈泊。
units.en: Its grazing lands lie at Daihabo, northeast of Taolin Subprefecture in Shanxi.
units.literal: Its pasture lies at Daihabo northeast of Shanxi's Taolin Subprefecture.

units.zh: 東界正紅旗察哈爾，西界鑲藍旗察哈爾，南界豐鎮，北界四子部落。
units.en: It borders Plain Red Banner Chahar on the east and Bordered Blue Banner Chahar on the west; on the south Fengzhen and on the north the Four Sons tribes.
units.literal: On the east it borders Plain Red Banner Chahar, on the west Bordered Blue Banner Chahar, on the south Fengzhen, on the north the Four Sons tribes.

units.zh: 廣五十里，袤二百里。
units.en: It measures fifty li across and two hundred li in length.
units.literal: Fifty li wide and two hundred li long.

units.zh: 其山南曰鴨兒山。
units.en: Its mountains: to the south, Duckling Mountain.
units.literal: Its mountains: to the south, Ya'er Mountain.

units.zh: 北，阿爾達布色山。
units.en: To the north, Aerdabuse Mountain.
units.literal: To the north, Aerdabuse Mountain.

units.zh: 東南，格爾白山。
units.en: To the southeast, Ge'erbai Mountain.
units.literal: To the southeast, Ge'erbai Mountain.

units.zh: 西南，烏爾姑蘇台山。
units.en: To the southwest, Wu'ergusutai Mountain.
units.literal: To the southwest, Wu'ergusutai Mountain.

units.zh: 北：漠惠圖河，源出敖托海泉，西流入鑲藍旗察哈爾，會安達河。
units.en: To the north: Mohuitu River rises at Aotuohai Spring, flows west into Bordered Blue Banner Chahar, and joins the Anda River.
units.literal: To the north: Mohuitu River, rising from Aotuohai Spring, flowing west into Bordered Blue Banner Chahar and joining the Anda River.

units.zh: 東南：莽喀圖河，源出正紅旗察哈爾，西北流，會阿拉齊河，入黛哈池，即奄遏下水海。
units.en: To the southeast: Mangkatu River rises in Plain Red Banner Chahar, flows northwest to meet the Alaqi River, and enters Daiha Pool—the Yan'e Lower Water Sea.
units.literal: To the southeast: Mangkatu River, rising in Plain Red Banner Chahar, flowing northwest to join the Alaqi River and enter Daiha Pool, which is the Yan'e Lower Water Sea.

units.zh: 正紅旗察哈爾駐古爾板拖羅海山，在張家口西北三百七十里。
units.en: Plain Red Banner Chahar is stationed at Gu'erbantuoluohai Mountain, three hundred seventy li northwest of Zhangjiakou.
units.literal: Plain Red Banner Chahar is stationed at Gu'erbantuoluohai Mountain, three hundred seventy li northwest of Zhangjiakou.

units.zh: 東南距京師八百里。
units.en: It lies eight hundred li southeast of the capital.
units.literal: Eight hundred li southeast of the capital.

units.zh: 漢，雁門郡北境。
units.en: In Han times it was the northern border of Yanmen Commandery.
units.literal: Under the Han, the northern border of Yanmen Commandery.

units.zh: 牧地當山西陶林廳之東北、豐鎮廳之北，奇爾泊。
units.en: Its grazing lands lie northeast of Taolin Subprefecture and north of Fengzhen Subprefecture in Shanxi, at Qierbo.
units.literal: Its pasture lies northeast of Shanxi's Taolin Subprefecture and north of Fengzhen Subprefecture, at Qierbo.

units.zh: 東界正黃旗察哈爾，西界鑲紅旗察哈爾，南界陸軍部右翼牧廠，北界四子部落。
units.en: It borders Plain Yellow Banner Chahar on the east and Bordered Red Banner Chahar on the west; on the south the Army Ministry Right Wing pasture office and on the north the Four Sons tribes.
units.literal: On the east it borders Plain Yellow Banner Chahar, on the west Bordered Red Banner Chahar, on the south the Army Ministry's Right Wing pasture office, on the north the Four Sons tribes.

units.zh: 廣五十五里，袤二百八十里。
units.en: It measures fifty-five li across and two hundred eighty li in length.
units.literal: Fifty-five li wide and two hundred eighty li long.

units.zh: 其山：東曰阿拍撻蘭台山。
units.en: Its mountains: to the east, Apaitalan Mountain.
units.literal: Its mountains: on the east, Apaitalan Mountain.

units.zh: 北，伊克和洛圖山。
units.en: To the north, Ikeheluotu Mountain.
units.literal: To the north, Ikeheluotu Mountain.

units.zh: 東北，哈撤克圖山。
units.en: To the northeast, Hacheketu Mountain.
units.literal: To the northeast, Hacheketu Mountain.

units.zh: 西北，插漢峰。
units.en: To the northwest, Chahan Peak.
units.literal: To the northwest, Chahan Peak.

units.zh: 南：昆都倫泉、葫蘆蘇台泉。
units.en: To the south: Kundulun Spring and Hulusutai Spring.
units.literal: To the south: Kundulun Spring and Hulusutai Spring.

units.zh: 北：諾爾孫泉，東南流入正黃旗察哈爾，為納林河，又東南注希爾池。
units.en: To the north: Nuo'ersun Spring flows southeast into Plain Yellow Banner Chahar as the Nalin River, then continues southeast into Xier Pool.
units.literal: To the north: Nuo'ersun Spring, flowing southeast into Plain Yellow Banner Chahar as the Nalin River, then southeast again into Xier Pool.

units.zh: 鑲白旗察哈爾駐布雅阿海蘇默，在獨石口西北二百四十五里。
units.en: Bordered White Banner Chahar is stationed at Buyaahaisumu, two hundred forty-five li northwest of Dushikou.
units.literal: Bordered White Banner Chahar is stationed at Buyaahaisumu, two hundred forty-five li northwest of Dushikou.

units.zh: 東南距京師七百七十里。
units.en: It lies seven hundred seventy li southeast of the capital.
units.literal: Seven hundred seventy li southeast of the capital.

units.zh: 明，開平衛西北邊。
units.en: In Ming times it was the northwest border of Kaiping Guard.
units.literal: Under the Ming, the northwest border of Kaiping Guard.

units.zh: 漢，上谷郡北境。
units.en: In Han times it was the northern border of Shanggu Commandery.
units.literal: Under the Han, the northern border of Shanggu Commandery.

units.zh: 牧地當獨石口廳治西北。
units.en: Its grazing lands lie northwest of the seat of Dushikou Subprefecture.
units.literal: Its pasture lies northwest of the seat of Dushikou Subprefecture.

units.zh: 東及南界陸軍部牧廠，西界正白旗察哈爾，北界正藍旗察哈爾。
units.en: On the east and south it borders the Army Ministry pasture office; on the west Plain White Banner Chahar and on the north Plain Blue Banner Chahar.
units.literal: On the east and south it borders the Army Ministry pasture office, on the west Plain White Banner Chahar, on the north Plain Blue Banner Chahar.

units.zh: 廣五十六里，袤一百九十七里。
units.en: It measures fifty-six li across and one hundred ninety-seven li in length.
units.literal: Fifty-six li wide and one hundred ninety-seven li long.

units.zh: 其山：南曰巴漢得兒山。
units.en: Its mountains: to the south, Bahander Mountain.
units.literal: Its mountains: to the south, Bahander Mountain.

units.zh: 西北，鐵柱山蒙名阿爾坦噶達蘇。
units.en: To the northwest, Iron Pillar Mountain (Mongol Altangadasu).
units.literal: To the northwest, Tiezhu Mountain, Mongol name Altangadasu.

units.zh: 其北，西爾哈池。
units.en: To its north lies Xierha Pool.
units.literal: To its north, Xierha Pool.

units.zh: 西北：紅鹽池蒙名烏蘭池、魁素池。
units.en: To the northwest: Red Salt Pool (Mongol Ulan Pool and Kuisu Pool).
units.literal: To the northwest: Red Salt Pool, Mongol names Ulan Pool and Kuisu Pool.

units.zh: 正白旗察哈爾駐布爾噶台，在獨石口西北二百九十里。
units.en: Plain White Banner Chahar is stationed at Bu'ergatai, two hundred ninety li northwest of Dushikou.
units.literal: Plain White Banner Chahar is stationed at Bu'ergatai, two hundred ninety li northwest of Dushikou.

units.zh: 東南距京師八百二十里。
units.en: It lies eight hundred twenty li southeast of the capital.
units.literal: Eight hundred twenty li southeast of the capital.

units.zh: 明，龍門衛邊外。
units.en: In Ming times it lay beyond the Longmen Guard frontier.
units.literal: Under the Ming, beyond the border of Longmen Guard.

units.zh: 漢，上谷郡北境。
units.en: In Han times it was the northern border of Shanggu Commandery.
units.literal: Under the Han, the northern border of Shanggu Commandery.

units.zh: 牧地當獨石口廳治之西北。
units.en: Its grazing lands lie northwest of the seat of Dushikou Subprefecture.
units.literal: Its pasture lies northwest of the seat of Dushikou Subprefecture.

units.zh: 東及北界鑲白旗察哈爾，西及南界鑲黃旗察哈爾。
units.en: On the east and north it borders Bordered White Banner Chahar; on the west and south, Bordered Yellow Banner Chahar.
units.literal: On the east and north it borders Bordered White Banner Chahar, on the west and south Bordered Yellow Banner Chahar.

units.zh: 廣七十八里，袤二百九十五里。
units.en: It measures seventy-eight li across and two hundred ninety-five li in length.
units.literal: Seventy-eight li wide and two hundred ninety-five li long.

units.zh: 其山：南曰清涼黑山蒙名魁屯喀喇。
units.en: Its mountains: to the south, Cool Black Mountain (Mongol Kuitunkala).
units.literal: Its mountains: to the south, Qinglianghei Mountain, Mongol name Kuitunkala.

units.zh: 西，喀喇峨博圖山，一名黑山。
units.en: To the west, Kalaebotu Mountain, also known as Black Mountain.
units.literal: To the west, Kalaebotu Mountain, also called Black Mountain.

units.zh: 東南，伊克得兒山，一名大馬鬣山。
units.en: To the southeast, Ikede'er Mountain, also known as Great Horse-Mane Mountain.
units.literal: To the southeast, Ikede'er Mountain, also called Great Horse-Mane Mountain.

units.zh: 西北：翁翁泊、黑水灤蒙名喀喇烏蘇。
units.en: To the northwest: Wengweng Marsh and Black Water Bend (Mongol Kalawusu).
units.literal: To the northwest: Wengweng Marsh and Heishuiluan, Mongol name Kalawusu.

units.zh: 鑲藍旗察哈爾駐阿巴漢喀喇山，在殺虎口東北九十里。
units.en: Bordered Blue Banner Chahar is stationed at Abahankala Mountain, ninety li northeast of Shakhukou.
units.literal: Bordered Blue Banner Chahar is stationed at Abahankala Mountain, ninety li northeast of Shakhukou.

units.zh: 東南距京師一千里。
units.en: It lies one thousand li southeast of the capital.
units.literal: One thousand li southeast of the capital.

units.zh: 明，大同府西北邊外。
units.en: In Ming times it lay beyond the northwest frontier of Datong Prefecture.
units.literal: Under the Ming, beyond the northwest border of Datong Prefecture.

units.zh: 漢，雁門郡沃陽縣地。
units.en: In Han times it was the territory of Woyang County in Yanmen Commandery.
units.literal: Under the Han, the territory of Woyang County in Yanmen Commandery.

units.zh: 牧地當山西寧遠廳之北。
units.en: Its grazing lands lie north of Ningyuan Subprefecture in Shanxi.
units.literal: Its pasture lies north of Shanxi's Ningyuan Subprefecture.

units.zh: 東界鑲紅旗察哈爾，西界山西歸化，南界山西大同，北界四子部落。
units.en: It borders Bordered Red Banner Chahar on the east; on the west Shanxi's Guihua, on the south Datong in Shanxi, and on the north the Four Sons tribes.
units.literal: On the east it borders Bordered Red Banner Chahar, on the west Shanxi's Guihua, on the south Shanxi's Datong, on the north the Four Sons tribes.

units.zh: 廣一百一十五里，袤一百六十里。
units.en: It measures one hundred fifteen li across and one hundred sixty li in length.
units.literal: One hundred fifteen li wide and one hundred sixty li long.

units.zh: 其山：東曰克丑山。
units.en: Its mountains: to the east, Kechou Mountain.
units.literal: Its mountains: on the east, Kechou Mountain.

units.zh: 西，烏蘭插伯山。
units.en: To the west, Wulanchabo Mountain.
units.literal: To the west, Wulanchabo Mountain.

units.zh: 東北，衣馬圖山。
units.en: To the northeast, Yimatou Mountain.
units.literal: To the northeast, Yimatou Mountain.

units.zh: 東南，朔隆峰。
units.en: To the southeast, Shuolong Peak.
units.literal: To the southeast, Shuolong Peak.

units.zh: 其水：南曰察哈音圖河，源出阿爾站嶺，西南流，會弩衡格爾、虎虎烏蘇二河，入烏蘭木倫河。
units.en: Its waters: to the south, Chahayintu River rises on Arzhan Ridge, flows southwest to meet the Nuhengge'er and Huhuwusu rivers, and enters the Ulanmulun River.
units.literal: Its waters: to the south, Chahayintu River, rising from Arzhan Ridge, flowing southwest to join the Nuhengge'er and Huhuwusu rivers and enter the Ulanmulun River.

units.zh: 東南，阿拉齊河，源出朔隆峰，東流至鑲紅旗察哈爾，納巴爾哈孫河，入黛哈池。
units.en: To the southeast, Alaqi River rises on Shuolong Peak, flows east into Bordered Red Banner Chahar, receives the Ba'erhasun River, and enters Daiha Pool.
units.literal: To the southeast, Alaqi River, rising from Shuolong Peak, flowing east to Bordered Red Banner Chahar, receiving the Ba'erhasun River, and entering Daiha Pool.

units.zh: 東北，硃喇馬台河，源出席喇峰，西南流，會喀喇烏蘇河、納札海河，為土爾根河，即黑河之上源。
units.en: To the northeast, Zhulamatai River rises on Xila Peak, flows southwest to meet the Kalawusu and Nazhahai rivers, and becomes the Tu'ergen River—the upper source of the Hei River.
units.literal: To the northeast, Zhulamatai River, rising from Xila Peak, flowing southwest to join the Kalawusu and Nazhahai rivers, forming the Tu'ergen River, which is the upper source of the Hei River.

units.zh: 黑河，源出海拉蘇台坡，與鑲紅旗察哈爾接界，西北流，有納札海、硃喇馬台等河，皆自東北來，與黑水河會。
units.en: The Hei River rises on Hailasutai Slope along the border with Bordered Red Banner Chahar and flows northwest; the Nazhahai, Zhulamatai, and other rivers enter from the northeast and join the Heishui River.
units.literal: The Hei River rises from Hailasutai Slope, borders Bordered Red Banner Chahar, flows northwest; the Nazhahai, Zhulamatai, and other rivers all come from the northeast and join the Heishui River.

units.zh: 又西流，受德布色黑河，折西南，合哲爾德河，始名伊克土爾根河，又西入歸化。
units.en: Continuing west, it receives the Debusehei River, turns southwest to meet the Zhe'erde River, and is then known as the Ike Tu'ergen River before entering Guihua farther west.
units.literal: It flows on west, receives the Debusehei River, turns southwest to join the Zhe'erde River, and is then called the Ike Tu'ergen River; it enters Guihua farther west.

units.zh: 正藍旗察哈爾駐札哈蘇台泊，在獨石口東北三百六十里。
units.en: Plain Blue Banner Chahar is stationed at Zhahasutai Marsh, three hundred sixty li northeast of Dushikou.
units.literal: Plain Blue Banner Chahar is stationed at Zhahasutai Marsh, three hundred sixty li northeast of Dushikou.

units.zh: 東南距京師八百九十里。
units.en: It lies eight hundred ninety li southeast of the capital.
units.literal: Eight hundred ninety li southeast of the capital.

units.zh: 明，開平衛北境。
units.en: In Ming times it was the northern border of Kaiping Guard.
units.literal: Under the Ming, the northern border of Kaiping Guard.

units.zh: 金，桓州地。
units.en: In Jin times it was the territory of Huanzhou.
units.literal: Under the Jin, the territory of Huanzhou.

units.zh: 牧地當直隸獨石口廳治之北。
units.en: Its grazing lands lie north of the seat of Dushikou Subprefecture in Zhili.
units.literal: Its pasture lies north of the seat of Zhili's Dushikou Subprefecture.

units.zh: 東界克什克騰，西界鑲白旗察哈爾，南界內務府正白旗羊群牧廠，北界阿巴噶左翼。
units.en: It borders Keshiketeng on the east and Bordered White Banner Chahar on the west; on the south the Interior Ministry Plain White Banner sheep pasture office and on the north Abag Left Wing.
units.literal: On the east it borders Keshiketeng, on the west Bordered White Banner Chahar, on the south the Interior Ministry's Plain White Banner sheep pasture office, on the north Abag Left Wing.

units.zh: 廣二百六十五里，袤九十五里。
units.en: It measures two hundred sixty-five li across and ninety-five li in length.
units.literal: Two hundred sixty-five li wide and ninety-five li long.

units.zh: 其水：東曰戈賀蘇台河，源出額默黑特站西，北流，會察察爾台、戈賀蘇台、奴黑特等河，入阿霸垓右翼。
units.en: Its waters: to the east, Gehesutai River rises west of Emoheite Station, flows north to meet the Chacha'ertai, Gehesutai, Nuheite, and other rivers, and enters Abag Right Wing.
units.literal: Its waters: to the east, Gehesutai River, rising west of Emoheite Station, flowing north to join the Chacha'ertai, Gehesutai, Nuheite, and other rivers and enter Abag Right Wing.

candidatePacket.instructions: Review dates, event ownership, conversions, endpoint evidence, age reckoning, omitted life dates, and active-date hints. Read all Chinese units for omissions; English is not independent evidence. Do not re-extract names or mentions. For each item identify whose event is dated and justify each endpoint. Same mother does not imply same birth year. Later allusions are not personal activity. Research or record a blocker rather than invent precision. A report cannot approve with missing checks or unresolved research.

findings.problem: The Ming-period genealogical wording is wrongly encoded as the unnamed Little Prince's personal AD 1368–1644 attestation and active-date hint.
findings.action: Remove the personal interval claim and hint, or retain the genealogy only in a nonpersonal contextual claim; do not substitute an invented date.

findings.problem: A 1675 event involving Burne is incorrectly treated as an AD 1675 personal attestation for his father Kökege Erjen.
findings.action: Remove the father’s later attestation while preserving Burne’s dated rebellion, execution, and the source-backed father-son relationship.
